mapper.select: select * from BOARD order by BOARD_ID desc;
mapper.update: update BOARD set VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 where BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: insert into BOARD(TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, PASSWORD) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{password})
mapper.update: update BOARD set TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, MODIFIED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.select: select COUNT(*) from BOARD where BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
